title: Run cargo fmt on the producer's work tree before checks and verifier
summary: Follow-up to rejected job 20261108-023649-67f6: its skill work is dropped and not retried here. This job does the fix its introspection (20261108-041919-1x5m) proposed: after the producer stage, Athena runs `cargo fmt` on the work tree and then `cargo fmt --check`, so a formatting-only defect no longer rejects a job. Audience: Sri and the verifier judging whether jobs are rejected for work rather than layout.

defaults_applied.how: The change is Rust code and tests.
Tests for the format step; cargo test, clippy and fmt --check are criteria.
Formatting is fixed by a mechanism in the pipeline, not by reformatting one file.
A code step enforces it, not a prompt rule.
Tests check that a mis-formatted tree is reformatted and that an unfixable error still fails.
Behavior criteria name cargo test commands.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs (producer_snapshot creates the work tree; producer_loop runs the producer, then send-backs for criteria, scope, mirrors and decisions), crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (produce_and_verify at about line 1737; checks run through routing::run_routed_with_record and SnapExec near line 2021, on the candidate), crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs (run_check) and crates/athena-agent/src/policy.rs (denies cargo fmt without --check to agent roles). The format step belongs at the end of producer_loop, before the change list is taken. No record or data file under crates/ is added, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not affected. The property is measured directly: the fmt check on the formatted tree.

Job 20261108-023649-67f6 addressed: its skill work (skills/diagnose-failure.md, introspect.rs and briefs.rs changes, its introspection test) is dropped, not kept. Its findings are not fixed here. The fmt finding is fixed at the root by this mechanism. The skill-path and PromptAsset-versioning findings do not apply because the skill is not re-added. A separate request can redo the skill.
Where a candidate is tree-seeded from an earlier rejected one, the formatter runs on it too, since the work tree is formatted after each producer stage.
Unfixable fmt errors (a parse error) are left in the tree; the normal fmt check fails and reports them.
The base and any pre-existing unformatted files can be reformatted by `cargo fmt`; accepted because the repository is expected to be fmt-clean at base.
Governance: athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, rust-toolchain.toml and rustfmt config are not changed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test in crates/athena-core builds a work tree whose Rust file is mis-formatted (e.g. a long constant on one line), runs the new post-producer format step, and asserts the file is rewritten and `cargo fmt --check` then passes. Run `cargo test -p athena-core` and it passes.

A new test shows a fmt failure the formatter cannot fix (e.g. a file that does not parse) still yields a failed fmt result whose output text appears in the failed-check output. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
Grep of crates/athena-core/src/run shows the format step is called after the producer loop and before the checks and verifier run, so the check and the verifier see the formatted tree.
A test asserts the recorded candidate diff (change list) includes the formatter's changes, not only the producer's own edits. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

The format step runs only for a work tree with a Cargo.toml and is Athena code, not an agent command, so the policy in crates/athena-agent/src/policy.rs that denies `cargo fmt` without --check to agent roles is unchanged.
CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased entry stating the outcome: a job whose only defect is rustfmt layout reaches the verifier formatted.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean on the workspace.

Job 20261108-023649-67f6's candidate files are not present: crates/athena-context/skills/diagnose-failure.md does not exist, and crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/introspection.rs are unchanged. No secrets or personal data are added.

out_of_scope: Job 20261108-023649-67f6 files, dropped: crates/athena-context/skills/diagnose-failure.md, crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/introspection.rs, and its CHANGELOG entry
Adding the diagnose-failure skill or any other skill
Changing athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows or rustfmt/toolchain configuration
Letting agent roles run cargo fmt without --check
departures: Pipeline change with several tests in a large run module raises cost and lowers the pass chance slightly against the reference.
urgent_reason: It cuts rejected attempts: the earlier job was rejected only for rustfmt layout, which a tool can repair without judgment.
hard_reason: It changes the run pipeline (what happens between the producer, the checks and the verifier) and what reaches the gate that judges jobs, so a mistake is costly and hard to see.
